prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: full-screen background illustration for a portrait casual mobile puzzle game, 720:1520 portrait ratio. BACKGROUND ART ONLY, no interface.
Primary request: Design a radically fresh 青瓷竹影 environment as an OPEN-AIR elegant Jiangnan courtyard at dawn. This must be a real outdoor landscape with depth, not an interior, a draped frame, or a blank paper backdrop.
Scene and composition: View slightly downward from a broad pale celadon glazed STONE garden table/chess-platform in the foreground, which extends from about 34% of image height to the bottom and provides one continuous subtly textured resting plane. The perspective plane is spacious and softly lit, pale seafoam-celadon with fine ceramic crackle and very subtle reflected ripples, NOT wood or parchment. Its middle remains uncluttered. Beyond its upper edge is a tranquil misty turquoise pond and a small low arched stone bridge, glimpsed between soft willow and bamboo at the far sides. A beautiful semicircular stone MOON GATE appears asymmetrically at the far UPPER RIGHT, cropped by the image edge, framing distant water and garden. Asymmetric landscape silhouette, varied architecture and natural depth. One small simple celadon tea cup, viewed in perspective, tucked in the far lower-right corner. No copper pot.
Lighting and palette: soft fresh dawn, airy turquoise mist, pale jade/celadon stone, cool pearly reflections, restrained warm sunrise at the horizon. Painterly detailed casual mobile game illustration with tactile carved stone, glazed ceramic and natural foliage; elegant and richly finished, softly atmospheric.
Functional composition: later an interface will be overlaid in fixed positions, so preserve low contrast behind top logo at y0–10%, a level bar y10–15%, progress y15%, central food-card cluster x21–75%, y34–57%, tray y74–82%, and buttons y91–96%. Do not draw those interface objects. Keep the central cluster area as a clear celadon stone plane with no big pattern, objects or high-contrast lines.
STRICT NEGATIVES: no text, letters, Chinese characters, numbers, logos, UI, buttons, food tile cards, trays, phone frames, people, watermarks. No giant blank rectangular rice-paper wall. No fabric swag or curtains. No symmetrical lantern pair. No twin side vases or potted plants on pedestals. No copper hotpot. No horizontal wood tabletop at 73% height. The open-air view and foreground celadon stone plane must be unmistakable.
